description: OrgAcuity is an AI-powered employee listening platform, going beyond traditional surveys to unlock the hidden dynamics that drive performance—relationships, collaboration, and networks. Our platform helps organizations retain top talent, accelerate change, and lead more effectively in the era of human-AI collaboration.
problem_statement:
Most companies are awash in engagement surveys and dashboards, but they still can’t see how work actually gets done or spot emerging risks early. Traditional employee listening tools were built for a world of static org charts, not today’s fluid, networked teams. They assume work happens in tidy boxes, measuring sentiment in isolation and ignoring the informal networks, relationships, and influencers that actually drive performance, retention, and change. The result is shallow insights and change efforts that push “action plans” to managers instead of working through the people who actually shape experiences and behavior.

OrgAcuity solves this by combining employee feedback with Organizational Network Analysis (ONA) and AI agents that translate signals into targeted, influencer-led actions. This matters because turnover, burnout, and failed change initiatives cost organizations billions, and most mid-market companies don’t have internal people analytics teams to unlock the value in their data. We give leaders a clear view of hidden barriers, overloaded connectors, and critical influencers, so they can retain key talent, strengthen culture, and drive measurable business outcomes without the guesswork and heavy consulting spend.

team.justification: The founding team of OrgAcuity demonstrates strong domain expertise and complementary skills. Craig Starbuck and Matt Milunski have a history of working together and have built the platform themselves, showcasing their execution capability. Their experience in HR analytics at Equifax provides them with relevant industry insights.
